original: Viṣṇu 99.20c/ sva-kārya-dakṣe para-kārya-dakṣe kalyāṇa-citte ca sadā vinīte //
analyzed: sva kārya dakṣe para kārya dakṣe kalyāṇa citte ca sadā vinīte

original: Viṣṇu 99.21a/ nārīṣu nityaṃ su-vibhūṣitāsu pati-vratāsu priya-vādinīṣu /
analyzed: nārīṣu nityam su vibhūṣitāsu pativratāsu priya vādinīṣu
amuktahastāsu suta anvitāsu su gupta bhāṇḍāsu bali priyāsu
saṃmṛṣṭa veśmāsu jita aindriyāsu kali vyapetāsu a vilolupāsu

original: Viṣṇu 99.22c/ dharma-vyapekṣāsu dayā-anvitāsu sthitā sadā^ahaṃ madhu-sūdane ca //
analyzed: dharma vyapekṣāsu dayā anvitāsu sthitā sadā aham madhusūdane ca

original: Viṣṇu 99.23a/ nimeṣa-mātraṃ ca vinā kṛtā^ahaṃ na jātu tiṣṭhe\ puruṣa-uttamena // (ā half verse.)
analyzed: nimeṣa mātram ca vinā na jātu tiṣṭhe puruṣauttamena half verse

original: Viṣṇu 100.01a/ dharma-śāstram idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svayaṃ devena bhāṣitam /
analyzed: dharma śāstram idam śreṣṭham svayam devena bhāṣitam

original: Viṣṇu 100.01c/ ye dvijā dhārayiṣyanti\ teṣāṃ svarge gatiḥ parā //
analyzed: ye dvijāḥ dhārayiṣyanti teṣām svarge gatiḥ parā

original: Viṣṇu 100.02a/ idaṃ pavitraṃ maṅgalyaṃ svargyam āyuṣyam eva ca /
analyzed: idam pavitram maṅgalyam svargyam āyuṣyam eva ca

original: Viṣṇu 100.02c/ jñānaṃ ca^eva yaśasyaṃ ca dhana-saubhāgya-vardhanam //
analyzed: jñānam ca eva yaśasyam ca dhana saubhāgya vardhanam

original: Viṣṇu 100.03a/ adhyetavyaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ śrāvyaṃ śrotavyam eva ca /
analyzed: adhyetavyam dhāraṇīyam śrāvyam śrotavyam eva ca

original: Viṣṇu 100.03c/ śrāddheṣu śrāvaṇīyaṃ ca bhūti-kāmair naraiḥ sadā //
analyzed: śrāddheṣu śrāvaṇīyam ca bhūti kāmaiḥ naraiḥ sadā

original: Viṣṇu 100.04a/ ya idaṃ paṭhate\ nityaṃ bhūti-kāmo naraḥ sadā /
analyzed: yaḥ idam paṭhate nityam bhūti kāmaḥ naraḥ sadā

original: Viṣṇu 100.04c/ idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathitaṃ ca dhare tava //
analyzed: idam rahasyam paramam kathitam ca dhare tava

original: Viṣṇu 100.05a/ mayā prasannena jagad-dhita-arthaṃ saubhāgyam etat paramaṃ yaśasyam /
analyzed: mayā prasannena jagat hita artham saubhāgyam etat paramam yaśasyam

original: Viṣṇu 100.05c/ duḥ-svapna-nāśaṃ bahu-puṇya-yuktaṃ śiva-ālayaṃ śāśvata-dharma-śāstram // [End of Part 2 = end of Viṣṇu.]
analyzed: viṣṇu 10005c duḥsvapna nāśam bahu puṇya yuktam śiva ālaya śāśvata dharmaśāstra
